It is located in {{ill|Noto Province|cs|Provincie Noto|de|Provinz Noto|es|Provincia de Noto|fa|ولایت نوتو|fr|Province de Noto|gl|Provincia de Noto|id|Provinsi Noto|it|Noto (provincia)|ja|能登国|ko|노토국|lt|Noto žemė|nl|Noto (provincie)|pt|Província de Noto|ru|Ното (провинция)|simple|Noto Province|sk|Noto (provincia)|sr|Провинција Ното|tr|Noto (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ното|zh|能登國|zh_min_nan|Noto-kok|zh_yue|能登國|qid=Q1047671|lt=Noto Province}}.

== Overview ==
It is located in the northeastern part of Suzu City. The enshrined deities are {{ill|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|de|Ninigi|eo|Ninigi|es|Ninigi no Mikoto|fa|نینیگی-نو-میکوتو|fr|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|id|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|it|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|ja|ニニギ|ko|니니기|mni|ꯅꯤꯅꯤꯒꯤ-ꯅꯣ-ꯃꯤꯀꯣꯇꯣ|nl|Ninigi|no|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|pl|Ninigi|pt|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|ru|Ниниги но Микото|simple|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|sv|Ninigi|th|นินิงิ โนะ มิโกโตะ|tl|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|tr|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|uk|Нініґі но мікото|vi|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|zh|瓊瓊杵尊|qid=Q1056017|lt=Amatsu-Hitaka-Hiko-Ho-no-Ninigi-no-Mikoto}}, Miho Susumi-no-Mikoto, {{ill|Konohanasakuya-hime|az|Konohanasakuya|ca|Konohana no Sakuya hime|de|Konohanasakuyahime|fa|کونوهاناساکویا-هیمه|fr|Konohana-no-Sakuya|it|Konohanasakuya-hime|ja|コノハナノサクヤビメ|ko|고노하나노사쿠야비메|mni|ꯀꯣꯅꯣꯍꯅꯁꯀꯨꯌ-ꯍꯤꯃꯦ|pl|Konohanasakuya-hime|ru|Коноханасакуя-химэ|sv|Konohanasakuyahime|th|เซ็นเง็ง|vi|Konohana Sakuya Hime|zh|木花開耶姬|qid=Q1781862|lt=Konohanasakuya-hime-no-Mikoto}}, and three others. Near Takakura-gu are Suzu Shrine Okumiya and Suzu Shrine Kinbun-gu.

It holds cultural properties including a wooden male deity statue designated as a national {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|de|Wichtiges Kulturgut Japans|es|Bien Cultural Importante de Japón|fi|Japanin tärkeä kulttuuriomaisuus|fr|Bien culturel important|id|Properti Kebudayaan Penting (Jepang)|it|Bene culturale importante (Giappone)|ja|重要文化財|ko|일본의 중요문화재|ro|Patrimoniu cultural important al Japoniei|simple|Important Cultural Properties of Japan|th|ทรัพย์สินทางวัฒนธรรมที่สำคัญ (ญี่ปุ่น)|tr|Önemli Kültürel Varlık (Japonya)|uk|Важливі культурні пам'ятки Японії|zh|重要文化財|qid=Q1188622}}. In the same quake, the temizuya was completely destroyed, doors of the main hall were warped, and stone lanterns and guardian dogs were also damaged<ref name="nikkansports20240121" />.

== Access ==
* By car
: From {{ill|Noto-Satoyama Kaidō|ja|のと里山海道|nl|Noto Satoyama kaido-autosnelweg|zh|能登里山海道|qid=Q11612031}}{{ill|Anamizu Interchange|ja|穴水インターチェンジ|zh|穴水交流道|qid=Q11597233|lt=Anamizu I.C.}}, go east via {{ill|Suzu Road|ja|珠洲道路|qid=Q11573344}}, then from the Rice Center-mae intersection take Prefectural Route 287 for about 1 hour.
* Public transport
: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Suzu Bus}}, Noro-Iida (sea) route bound for "Noro," get off at "Suzu Jinja-mae"<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.city.suzu.lg.jp/site/kankou/1530.html |title=Suzu Shrine |publisher=Suzu City |date=2022-01-17 |accessdate=2024-01-12 }}</ref>.
